messages:
sara: Quick idea — let's run a 3-hour site copy retreat next Wed to lock Hosted / Dedicated / Private page copy and the launch post angles. goal: shipping a single coherent narrative + 2 hero variants for A/B testing.

leo: +1. can we include the webinar landing + the inbound form routing logic in the same session? that will speed handoffs. :rocket:

anya: love it. i'll bring the benchmark narratives (latency/cost/reliability) and a short deck with customer voice snippets.

matt: i can map the funnel routing for leads — which segments go to webinar list vs demo requests vs dedicated-sales. will need the form fields decided.

julia: recommend we set timeboxes: 30m for hero messaging, 45m for body/value props + proof points, 30m for webinar CTA & assets, 30m for inbound routing + UTMs, 15m for next steps/owners.

sara: that breakdown works. propose 9:00–12:00 PT. anyone blocked?

leo: i'm on holiday morning but can make 10:00–13:00 PT if that helps.

anya: 10–13 PT is fine for me. julia?

julia: ok for 10–13. matt ok?

matt: yes. switch confirmed.

content-bot: Reminder: attach pre-read 24h before meeting. use template: `./copy/briefs/site-copy-retreat.md`

anya: pre-read will include: benchmark snippets, 4 competitor lines, 3 customer quotes, and a proposed hero matrix (hosted/dedicated/private).

sara: for the hero matrix let's test these axes: "predictable latency", "cost transparency", "deployment flexibility". need short benefit-led headlines for each mode.

leo: draft suggestions:
- Hosted: "Instant LLM inference — production performance, zero ops"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs"
- Private: "Self-hosted inference with enterprise-grade controls"

julia: nice. let's make Hosted more PLG-forward: "Get started in minutes — enterprise-grade inference" and Dedicated lean into economics: "Predictable throughput, optimized unit costs"

matt: on inbound routing, here's the quick rule: form selects "Use case" + "Team size". if team size >50 or "Compliance" checkbox true => route to enterprise-sales; else if use case is "evaluation" => webinar nurture; else demo request => AE queue. also add metadata UTM params: `utm_source=launch`, `utm_campaign=tri-mode-site`

anya: saving that. can we also capture model/throughput estimate? useful for pre-qualification.

sara: yes add a dropdown: "expected requests per minute" with ranges. matt — implement routing rules in HubSpot?

matt: will draft the HubSpot workflow. i'll include fallback: if no response in 48h, auto-nudge and assign CS rep.

leo: webinar planning — we should align the narrative to benchmarks: 1 slide on latency, 1 on cost per 1k tokens w/ batching, 1 on fallback/routing. goal: 30–40 minute webinar + 15m live Q&A.

anya: i'll prepare a short benchmark run and a one-pager with charts. aim to include 2 customer quotes about moving from experimental to production.

julia: copy task owners: hero lines (leo), body/value props (anya), proof points/benchmarks (anya), webinar slides (anya + leo), form fields + routing (matt), AB test variants + GTM copy (sara).

sara: thanks — i'll own final sign-off and launch post drafts. action items:
1) anya: attach benchmark doc and hero matrix pre-read (by Tue 5pm PT)
2) leo: draft hero headlines + 2 short launch post angles (by Tue 5pm PT)
3) matt: initial HubSpot routing draft + field list (by Tue 5pm PT)
4) julia: facilitator + timebox owner, collate notes post-retreat

matt: noted. will also add tracking snippet for the demo confirmation page: `window.dataLayer.push({event: 'demo_submitted', utm_campaign: 'tri-mode-site'});`

content-bot: Scheduled meeting: Wed 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent. pre-read due Tue 17:00 PT. :white_check_mark:

leo: great. quick ask — for launch post angles, can one be a benchmark-first narrative and the other a customer-first story?

anya: that's the plan. benchmark-first for technical channels, customer-first for product/marketing socials.

sara: perfect. let's keep copy concise — hero + three bullets + CTA. we'll iterate copy in the retreat and have final drafts for review by Friday. thanks everyone! :clap:
